pick.headline: Gas leak at Union Carbide plant kills thousands in Bhopal
pick.summary: On the night of 2-3 December 1984 methyl isocyanate gas leaked from the Union Carbide pesticide plant in Bhopal, India, killing thousands.
pick.significance: The world's worst industrial disaster put an American corporation's conduct abroad on trial.

alternates.headline: East German Politburo resigns
alternates.summary: On 3 December 1989 the entire Politburo and Central Committee of East Germany's ruling party resigned, and Erich Honecker and other former leaders were expelled from the party.
alternates.significance: The party's collapse left the GDR state without its leadership weeks after the Wall opened.

alternates.headline: Carapintada officers rise against Argentina's government
alternates.summary: On 3 December 1990 rebel army officers loyal to Colonel Mohamed Ali Seineldin seized army headquarters in Buenos Aires. Loyal troops put down the uprising within a day, at a cost of over a dozen lives.
alternates.significance: It was the last of the 'carapintada' rebellions against civilian rule, and came on the eve of a visit by President Bush.
